# NiONlite

NiONlite LLC is an independent mobile app studio building focused iOS and Android apps.

Website: https://nionlite.com/
Contact: support@nionlite.com

## Apps

### Contractor Proposals

Contractor Proposals is available for iPhone and iPad. Contractors can capture site photos, enter measurements and rates, draft written design directions on-device, build Good / Better / Best packages, share branded proposal PDFs, and track approvals, deposits, invoices, payments, and closeout.

Primary page: https://nionlite.com/contractor.html
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/contractor-proposals/id6814047447
Privacy Policy: https://nionlite.com/contractor-privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://nionlite.com/contractor-terms.html

Key features:
- Six trade modules: landscaping, decks/patios/porches, painting, kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, and room design
- Editable estimates, written scope suggestions, and contractor review before publishing
- Branded proposal and invoice PDFs, with manually recorded approval and payment status
- On-device storage, backup file export and restore, and a sample proposal in Settings
- Monthly and annual Contractor Pro plans, with a 7-day trial for eligible Apple Accounts
- Existing projects and published PDFs remain viewable and shareable without Pro

Version 1.0.1 includes the refreshed app icon, clearer selected-tab styling, and clearer trial and billing disclosures.

### CUB: Track Daily Mortgage Rate

CUB: Track Daily Mortgage Rate is a finance app for iOS and Android that helps users compare published mortgage rates from credit unions and banks.

Primary page: https://nionlite.com/cub-rates.html
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cub-track-daily-mortgage-rate/id6761875184
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.NiONlite.bcurates.bcu_rates

Key features:
- Free best-rate snapshot and mortgage calculator with monthly, yearly, and one-time extra payments
- Free, optional push notifications for new rate publications on supported app versions, with no CUB account required
- One-time Premium passes through the App Store or Google Play that expire at the end of the selected term
- Premium lender list, profiles, state and membership filters, favorites, and up to one year of rate history
- Premium target-rate alerts for a selected lender, loan type, and threshold. Email delivery requires a verified CUB account.

CUB is not a lender, mortgage broker, or loan marketplace. It is an informational research app that helps users compare publicly available mortgage rate information and confirm details directly with lenders.

Useful CUB pages:
- https://nionlite.com/credit-union-mortgage-rate-tracker.html
- https://nionlite.com/mortgage-rate-alert-app.html
- https://nionlite.com/compare-credit-union-mortgage-rates-by-state.html
- https://nionlite.com/mortgage-rate-calculator-extra-payments.html
- https://nionlite.com/cub-vs-lender-websites.html
- https://nionlite.com/credit-unions-vs-banks-mortgage-rates.html
- https://nionlite.com/best-credit-union-mortgage-rates-virginia.html
- https://nionlite.com/how-to-get-lowest-mortgage-rate.html

### Plate Atlas

Plate Atlas is an AI menu scanner, dietary checker, and restaurant food journal for iOS and Android.

Primary page: https://nionlite.com/plate-atlas.html
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/plate-atlas/id6764467007
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nionlite.plateatlas

Key features:
- AI menu scanner and dish lookup
- Dietary profile, allergen, disliked ingredient, and custom warning checks
- Saved dishes and restaurant food journal
- Safe-for-me tags and post-meal notes
- Map view for restaurants connected to saved dishes

### ByWhen

ByWhen is a smart deadline reminder app available for iOS on the App Store and Android on Google Play.

Primary page: https://nionlite.com/bywhen.html
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bywhen-deadline-planner/id6778767584
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nionlite.bywhen

Key features:
- Adaptive reminder planning based on deadline risk and task duration
- Calendar-aware reminder windows with Apple Calendar, Android Calendar, and optional Apple Reminders import
- Sleep, work hours, workdays, and out-and-away task rules
- Recurring daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and selected-weekday tasks
- Task-specific reminder styles and notification actions
- Color-coded Plan timeline with suggested sessions, task search in Today and Plan, and finished-task history
- Current iOS versions include 14 days of Premium for new users with no payment required and no automatic subscription
- Android trial availability and terms depend on the eligible Google Play subscription offer
- Planning runs on-device. Exports and system backups are separate from planning.

Privacy policy: https://nionlite.com/bywhen-privacy.html
Terms of use: https://nionlite.com/bywhen-terms.html

ByWhen guides:
- https://nionlite.com/blog/smart-deadline-reminder-app.html
- https://nionlite.com/blog/calendar-aware-reminders-guide.html
- https://nionlite.com/blog/recurring-reminders-for-chores-errands.html
